cues.text: Stop eating random amounts of protein
and wondering why you still look the
same. Let me fix that. You only need
three simple rules to build muscle
properly. First, protein amount. [music]
Most guys eat way too little. If you
want to build muscle, aim for around 0.7
to 1 g of protein per pound of body
weight. [music] That's where growth
actually happens. Second, protein
timing. Your body doesn't care if you
eat all your protein in one giant meal
like a starving bear. Spread it across
the day. Three to four high-protein
meals works [music] best. That keeps
muscle protein synthesis active. Third,
protein quality. Junk protein gives junk
results. Focus on real sources. Eggs,
[music] chicken, beef, Greek yogurt,
fish, whey protein. That's the stuff
that actually helps you grow. That's it.
Three simple fixes and suddenly your
workouts start looking like progress
instead of cardio.

Your body doesn't care if you eat all your protein in one giant meal like a starving bear. Spread it across the day. Three to four high-protein meals works [music] best. That keeps muscle protein synthesis active. Third, protein quality. Junk protein gives junk results. Focus on real sources. Eggs, [music] chicken, beef, Greek yogurt, fish, whey protein.
